children: Arrive AI entered into a Securities Purchase Agreement for a $250,000 private investment in public equity. The company sold 384,615 common shares and a warrant to purchase 384,615 shares at a combined price of $0.65 per unit; the warrant is immediately exercisable at $0.70 per share and expires Oct 5, 2031, with cashless exercise available. Arrive AI will file a resale registration statement within 20 days and intends to use proceeds for working capital.
